top_issues: Primary breakdown bars underneath hero balance lack explicit labels directly attached to segments, relying on an educational banner below.
Educational callout takes substantial vertical space without clear primary action.
fixes: Integrate direct tooltips and inline labels onto balance bar segments.
Make educational banner dismissible permanently with compact state.

top_issues: Right sidebar contains dual capacity comparisons that create visual redundancy.
Hex entity addresses dominate visual weight over verified counterparty labels.
fixes: Collapse before/after comparison into a unified interactive state preview.
Truncate hex addresses with one-click copy and display human-readable handles prominently.

top_issues: Receipt modal lacks immediate one-click share link generation for external recipients.
Runtime proof hash provides no inline verification link or block explorer jump.
fixes: Add direct copyable public web-proof link button alongside raw receipt.
Add interactive inspect state to the cryptographic proof identifier.

top_issues: Large inverted QR code visual block clashes with dark mode canvas balance.
Inbound capacity constraints are secondary rather than warning upfront if limits are tight.
fixes: Style QR card container with subtle borders matching the dark surface palette.
Prominently highlight maximum receivable amount directly above the QR code.

top_issues: Orderbook depth bars and spread indicators compress numeric details in right column.
Explanatory footnote text regarding gross receive and tariffs creates high cognitive load.
fixes: Simplify order book column width and increase font tabular figures alignment.
Convert collateral tariff explanation into a clean expandable disclosure.

top_issues: Action bar has five disparate buttons competing equally for attention.
Credit limit versus collateral delta lacks visual distinction from standard balance lines.
fixes: Group Pay, Swap, and Manage into a prioritized primary/secondary button hierarchy.
Emphasize the collateralized portion with distinct line weight and indicator marks.

top_issues: Filter pills at top left do not clearly indicate active counts or dates.
Inspection detail panel on right repeats summary line without deep frame logs.
fixes: Add item counts to category pills and date-range filtering control.
Include expandable transition payload preview inside the inspection card.

top_issues: Identical to previous activity frame without distinguishing state changes.
Right-hand receipt card leaves large empty vertical space below proof.
fixes: Populate extended frame signatures and network verification metadata in bottom space.
Add explicit export button for individual transaction proof bundle.

top_issues: Very long vertical scroll layout with disparate visual settings intermixed with critical key controls.
Bar scale calibration slider is abstract for non-technical users.
fixes: Split settings into tabbed navigation for Appearance, Scales, Runtime, and Security.
Provide concrete monetary presets with visual preview examples for scale calibration.

top_issues: Card grid selector for From/To locations introduces matrix complexity.
Explanation box on top right feels disconnected from final call-to-action button.
fixes: Streamline From/To selection into unified transfer source selector.
Position operation consequence summary immediately above the final execution button.

top_issues: Navigation cards on left are disparate in scope, mixing protocol governance with asset move.
Low density and unbalanced negative space on wide viewport.
fixes: Organize options into categoric groups: Funds, Governance, Counterparties.
Adopt two-column balanced layout with summarized operational metrics.

top_issues: Faucet controls and testing parameters are blended directly into core asset screens.
Credit limit extension slider lacks immediate plain-language risk trade-off summary.
fixes: Move developer faucet utilities into designated testing sandbox section.
Add explicit risk warnings on the collateral versus credit toggle.

top_issues: Pool utilization and counterparty risks are sparsely detailed on right card.
Basis point input creates friction for users expecting standard annual APY.
fixes: Show projected net earnings alongside basis points and equivalent APY.
Display pool historical repayment performance and active liquidity charts.

top_issues: Dense explanatory copy dominates the card without diagrams of key threshold rules.
Right-side takeover module is empty with static informational text.
fixes: Render visual multi-sig threshold indicator showing active vs required keys.
Add direct action flow to initiate signer rotation or add cosigner.

top_issues: Download action for evidence bundle lacks preview of bundle contents and size.
Dispute flow entry point is a plain text link rather than a clear action.
fixes: Add manifest breakdown showing number of frames and signatures inside bundle.
Elevate Initiate Dispute into a prominent secondary button with confirmation modal.

top_issues: Dense tabular ledger mixes diverse metric columns with minimal horizontal breathing room.
Orderbook depth bars and spread text compete with dense balance grid.
fixes: Add subtle alternating row fills and customizable column toggles.
Allow collapsing or detaching order book panel in desktop view.

top_issues: Command palette obscures active workspace context without background dimming tuning.
Search hints do not show keyboard navigation shortcuts or direct filter syntax.
fixes: Add category badges and keyboard jump keys next to each search result.
Enable immediate fuzzy search filtering across counterparties and transaction IDs.

overall.verdict: The desktop dark interface maintains a cohesive design language with consistent technical styling and robust cryptographic status cues. However, it leans heavily on domain-specific abstractions and dense text blocks that hinder rapid comprehension for non-technical users.
priority_fixes: Add plain-language financial terms alongside protocol jargon across balances and transfers.
Integrate clear shareable receipts and export flows directly into payment confirmations.
Separate developer/faucet testing tools from production account and asset management.
Improve visual hierarchy in dense views through adjustable column spacing and interactive filters.
Provide step-by-step guided flows for dispute resolution and multi-signature operations.
